name: nadocast-day2-wind-benchmark-v1
product: Day 2 severe thunderstorm wind: probability of a Thunderstorm Wind report >= 50 kt within 25 miles (40.2336 km) of a point during the convective day D+1 12Z to D+2 12Z (issue date D)

issue_and_cutoff.ours: 12Z HRRR on D, f24-f48; assumed issuance 15Z D (init + 3 h)
issue_and_cutoff.nadocast: 12Z run on D (HREF/SREF), f24-47 = convective day D+1; same model cycle as ours
issue_and_cutoff.decision_cutoff: 18Z on D (afternoon Day 2 decision); NadoCast HTTP Last-Modified must be at or before 18Z D or the date is dropped from the head-to-head (reported variants: that variant only)

window_check: Ours: valid_start = init + 24 h, valid_end = init + 48 h (tools/severe/protocol.py, day2-12z-f24-48). NadoCast: hourly targets centred on f24..f47 (+-30 min) and the day period file f24-47, convective days 12Z-12Z (lib/StormEvents.jl). Same convective day.

wind_definitions.ours_labels: NCEI Storm Events EVENT_TYPE 'Thunderstorm Wind', MAGNITUDE >= 50 kt (measured or estimated); reports with missing/zero magnitude make points within 25 miles UNKNOWN (label 255), which are dropped for every model
wind_definitions.nadocast_primary_target: Storm Data Thunderstorm Wind >= 50 kt (README); missing magnitude treated as 50 kt in NadoCast training
wind_definitions.nadocast_wind_adj: different target (estimated reports re-weighted by a regional normalization); reported only, never deciding

models.live_v07: research/severe/baseline-v07/models.json day2_wind (live production, regional box only)
models.conus_v07_recipe: frozen CONUS refit of the v0.7 recipe (research/severe/conus-v1/frozen/models.pkl, manifest-checked)

grid_and_footprints.grid: our CONUS sample centres (stride-5 HRRR, 40,311); NadoCast = nearest point on its 387x226 15.237 km grid, which must be within 11 km
grid_and_footprints.regional: v0.7 regional box (-100..-75 E, 30..45 N) supported samples with a NadoCast point within 11 km: all five models
grid_and_footprints.conus: all supported samples (within 25 miles of US land) with a NadoCast point within 11 km: the four national models (not live v0.7)
grid_and_footprints.breakouts: CONUS comparison also reported for florida_gulf_south and west (and the other regions of conus_study.regions) so national averages do not hide regional misses

labels: Day 2 labels from the existing CONUS extraction artifacts (runs 44942885255 and 44961446546; pinned 2024 Storm Events, labels-v04 manifest); identical for every model

dates.previously_inspected_definition: the 96 2024 dates already scored for Day 2 wind in the CONUS study (12), 36-date follow-up and 48-date calibration test

excluded.not_considered: 2021 and 2025 (sealed), 2022-23 (training/calibration years of every our-side model), 2026 (Storm Events not final)

passes_if: NadoCast wind files fetched, hash-pinned and decode as WINDPROB 24-47 in percent
both footprints keep >= 95% of their supported samples with a NadoCast point within 11 km
all five models produce finite probabilities from the frozen files

metrics.brier: per footprint and region; each model minus NadoCast with a PAIRED date-bootstrap 95% interval (same resampled dates for both, 5000 draws, seed 20261122); in the regional footprint also each model minus live v0.7
at_each_threshold: false-alarm area km2/day (no-report points with p >= t, 225 km2 per sample)
metrics.equal_false_alarm_area: for NadoCast's false-alarm area at 5% and at 15% (per footprint/region), each model's hits when its own threshold is set so its false-alarm area does not exceed that area
metrics.reading: A difference is called only if its 95% paired interval excludes zero.

maps.active_day: fresh issue date with the most wind report points in the CONUS footprint
maps.quiet_or_false_alarm_day: fresh issue date with the largest no-report area where the mean of the four national models plus live v0.7 (box) is >= 5% (symmetric; favours no model)
maps.layout: one figure per case: live v0.7 (box), CONUS v0.7 refit, logistic, boosted trees, NadoCast, plus a reports panel

sealed: 2021 and 2025 never requested; live v0.7 map and the RRFS/NBM collector unchanged
